algorithm: One preselected FP32 FEM trajectory plus explicit conditional-QUBO CPU refinement
timing: FEM A100: process launch through host-available partition, including native input setup and conditional-QUBO CPU refinement; cached modes and prior calibration excluded. statistics: Best native cut of three trials; median per-trial process wall time from the same three runs; not time to the best-of-three cut
